items.title: Did Chemours' (CC) US$455 Million PFAS Deal Just Reframe Its Long‑Term Liability Narrative?

The agreement not only clears a significant portion of Chemours’ legacy PFAS exposure but also introduces a shared, net-present-value framework under the companies’ existing US$4.00 billion cost-sharing cap, potentially...
